title: COUPLING: producers fed by decomposer-processed substrate (cyclic+floor) on the 0.01 config?

identity.note: The probe always ran from the current checkout. A historical arm spec applied here is a settings replay, not a reproduction of its original figure.

preregistration.hypothesis: Step 2b hit the nutrient wall: rain nearly gone, regen and excretion zeroed, producers 0 on 8/18. nutrientCyclic scales regeneration by locally PROCESSED substrate (biotic mineralisation), coupling producers to decomposer activity; the 0.05 floor is the deadlock recovery the A+C post-mortem prescribed; saturation 1.0 replaces the falsified-tight 0.4. mixotrophyCarbon stays off: one coupling at a time.
preregistration.prediction: prod > 0 on at least 12/18 AND cons > 0 on at least 12/18 seeds at tick 6000 (both machine criteria). Coexistence rate NOT predicted.
preregistration.falsification: FALSIFIED if prod = 0 on 7 or more of 18 seeds: the coupling does not feed producers — loosen saturation further or abandon the coupling; do NOT raise light to compensate (the pcap sweep proved light rotates collapse). If cons = 0 on >=7/18 while producers recover, the failure is consumer viability, a separate mechanism.
preregistration.notPredicted: Coexistence rates, capture shares, extinction counts (descriptive), decomposer endpoints.
confoundsControlled: Same 18-seed panel, horizon, engine, lifts as graze-subsidy01; the ONLY differences are the three positional coupling dials cyc off->on, sat 0.4->1.0, nfloor 0->0.05

One-dial-per-arm is deliberately bent here and stated: the three are interdependent parts of one coupling (cyclic without a floor risks the measured deadlock; 0.4 saturation was already falsified as too tight). A lone-cyc arm would test a known-deadlocked configuration
conservation enforced per seed at 0.5%; a seed above it fails the run rather than reporting

criteria.statement: producers > 0 at tick 6000 on at least 12/18 seeds
consumers > 0 at tick 6000 on at least 12/18 seeds
